description: t_normalize: a written TimelineDoc + the caller's takes (+ the stored revision) → the normalized document or its problems [code, track, clip] (README, Timeline rules)

cases.description: V1 laid end to end from 0, every time snapped, defaults filled; a video take without in/out is whole; A2 named by position
23.976: times on the 1001/24000 grid
out past the take's end
out before in, and a clip under one frame
image rules: no in/out, a hold is required and at least one frame
a hold on a video take
empty slots: a hold, black; on V1 only
audio track rules: images and silent takes refused, at required, no overlap, nothing past the end, no dissolve
audio clips sorted by at; touching clips do not overlap
a valid dissolve: handles on both sides
dissolve on the first clip, next to an empty slot, without handles
a dissolve from an image needs no outgoing handle; dissolves longer than their clip
a take the stored revision named but the caller no longer has is offline (kept, no trim check); a new unknown one is take_not_found
take_not_found: a take (or an alternative) the stored revision did not name
alternatives: the current take is added at the end when missing
a shot the stored revision has is kept; a new one is shot_invalid
duplicate clip ids
track layout: V1 first, exactly one video track
track layout: a second video track
no V1 clip: the length is the last sound's
an empty sequence
a 25 fps take on a 24 fps sequence: source times snapped to the sequence's grid
1.32: an audio take is a clip on an audio track: in / out on the sample grid (out defaults to its end), at on a frame, gain and alternatives as any clip
1.32: an audio take on V1 is wrong_track (it has no picture); past V1's end on A2 is past_end, as any sound
1.32: a New line's placeholder on an audio track (no take, at, hold, the stored revision's shot): its at and hold on frames; it plays nothing
1.32: an empty slot without a shot on an audio track is still wrong_track; a placeholder needs at and must not overlap
1.29: a V1 clip's shot number is kept as written; an audio-track clip's is dropped (README, Timeline rules: shot numbers)
1.50: links and markers kept: markers snapped and sorted by time, then id
1.50: a link to no V1 clip: link_not_v1
1.50: a link on a V1 clip: link_track
1.50: a marker past the end: marker_past_end
1.50: a marker id twice: duplicate_marker
1.50: more than 200 markers: too_many_markers
1.50: an empty marker list is left out
